audit_mode: Read-only raw completed campaign; manually reconstructed measurements, scores and command authority; no SUT/model calls

bottleneck_evidence.behavioral_supported: Frozen reward uses actual-local errors. Fresh SW improves actual-local heading while worsening ideal heading in both midpoint seeds. This documents objective/measurement tradeoff, not proof of a reward-only cause. Seed11 active yaw moves toward the ideal direction while seed29 moves away; blanket countersteering explanations are false.
bottleneck_evidence.hard_supported: The first8m receives20 active10Hz commands then about15s of residual-off fixed-frame feedback. Endpoint drift remains approximately.36-.37m above strict.28m. Boundary states close to ideal heading later return toward the selected midpoint frame; this is a concrete authority/reference limit for strict end-of-long-Walk recovery.
not_isolated: Two-second activation limit versus broader controller/body dynamics
Generalization beyond the frozen16 fresh tuples or stochastic disturbances

critical_conclusions: Midpoint has genuine same-frame long16m Y/heading/endpoint gains in both trained seeds; this is separate from its deterministic frame advantage.
Midpoint12m heading/endpoint improve in both seeds, while final lateral worsens from a nearly-zero own-frame baseline; no rounding away of this tradeoff.

Fresh core target geometry is not uniformly more seed-consistent at midpoint. The defined family-mean core table gives three both-lower combinations at midpoint versus five at actual; this is descriptive, not a new scientific score.
All four models increase mean fresh target absolute ideal heading versus their own frame baseline; no universal fresh global-heading learning gain.
Midpoint fresh WT turn translation improves in both seeds but heading costs increase; fresh SW local-heading improvement coexists with ideal-heading worsening in both seeds.

All primary nominal/physical scores are preserved; midpoint first8m strict EXCESSIVE_DRIFT remains for off and both learned seeds. Strict25/26 seen-case diagnostics are not relabeled PASS or retroactively made a new hard gate.
Every observed command residual after2s is zero. Early learned effects are real but do not grant continuing authority; persistent later effects can arise from physical/base recurrent state.
Both midpoint final long16m worldY gains accumulate mainly after the first8m rather than recovering its strict corridor.
